title: Quantifying Subliminal Behavioral Transfer Ratios in Language Model Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2606.11270v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Distillation of a language model intended to transfer benign behavior to a student model may also transfer undesirable characteristics, if they are present in the teacher model, a phenomenon known as subliminal learning. While qualitative evidence supports the existence of this effect, its magnitude has not been systematically characterized. This study quantifies subliminal behavioral transfer ratios by steering two teacher models (Llama-2-7B-Chat and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) at varying steering strengths and distilling student models using only benign data. Evaluation on 100 JailbreakBench prompts with GPT-4.1, serving as the evaluator, indicates that transfer is robust but exhibits distinct scaling behaviors. Llama-2 demonstrates a sharp threshold ($\tau = {0.25,0.32} \ \text{beyond} \ \alpha = -0.15$), whereas Qwen2.5 displays continuous and higher levels of transfer ($\tau$ up to $0.61$).

translated_title: 量化语言模型蒸馏中的潜意识行为迁移比率
translated_abstract: 语言模型蒸馏旨在将良性行为迁移至学生模型，但如果教师模型中存在不良特性，蒸馏过程也可能将这些不良特性一并迁移，这一现象被称为“潜意识学习”。尽管已有定性证据支持这一效应的存在，但其程度尚未得到系统性的刻画。本研究通过以不同的引导强度对两个教师模型（Llama-2-7B-Chat 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）进行引导，并仅使用良性数据蒸馏学生模型，从而量化了潜意识行为迁移比率。在100条 JailbreakBench 提示上以 GPT-4.1 作为评估器的评测表明，行为迁移是稳健的，但表现出不同的缩放行为：Llama-2 呈现出急剧的阈值效应（在 α = -0.15 之外 τ = 0.25、0.32），而 Qwen2.5 则表现出连续且更高水平的迁移（τ 最高达 0.61）。
tldr: 本研究首次系统量化了语言模型蒸馏中“潜意识学习”的行为迁移比率，发现仅用良性数据蒸馏也会迁移教师模型的不良行为，且 Llama-2 呈急剧阈值式迁移而 Qwen2.5 呈连续且更高的迁移水平。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first systematic quantification of subliminal behavioral transfer ratios in language model distillation, showing that distillation on purely benign data still transfers undesirable teacher behaviors, with Llama-2 exhibiting a sharp threshold effect while Qwen2.5 displays continuous and higher transfer levels.
